title.zh: 卷六 唐本紀第六: 明宗
title.raw: 卷六 唐本紀第六: 明宗 Volume 6 Later Tang Annals 3: Mingzong

sentences.zh: 明宗聖德和武欽孝皇帝，世本夷狄，無姓氏。

translations.literal: Mingzong, the Sagacious Emperor of Sacred Virtue, Harmonious Martiality, and Reverent Filiality—his family were originally northern barbarians and had no surname.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong, temple name for the emperor of sacred virtue, harmonious martial bearing, and reverent filial piety, came of barbarian stock on his father’s side and bore no clan name.

sentences.zh: 父霓，為雁門部將，生子邈佶烈，以騎射事太祖，為人質厚寡言，執事恭謹，太祖養以為子，賜名嗣源。

translations.literal: His father Ni was a general of the Yanmen garrison division. He begot Mo Jilie, who served the Founding Sovereign with horsemanship and archery. The man was substantial and honest, taciturn, reverent and careful in office. The Founding Sovereign raised him as a son and bestowed the name Siyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ni held a post as an officer of the Yanmen command. Ni’s son Mo Jilie won favor for mounted archery in the service of Li Keyong, the founding sovereign of Jin: steady, sparing of words, exact in duty. Keyong adopted him and gave him the name Siyuan.

sentences.zh: 梁攻兗、鄆，朱宣、朱瑾來乞師，太祖遣李存信將兵三萬救之。

translations.literal: Liang attacked Yan and Yun prefectures. Zhu Xuan and Zhu Jin came begging for troops. The Founding Sovereign sent Li Cunxin with thirty thousand men to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang struck Yan and Yun, Zhu Xuan and Zhu Jin pleaded for aid. Keyong dispatched Li Cunxin at the head of thirty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 存信留莘縣不進，使嗣源別以兵三幹先擊梁兵，梁兵解去。

translations.literal: Cunxin remained at Shen County and did not advance, but ordered Siyuan separately to lead three thousand men in a prior strike against Liang troops; the Liang army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxin camped at Shen County and would not move forward. He sent Siyuan ahead with three thousand horse to hit Liang first; the enemy broke off and left.

sentences.zh: 存信留莘縣久之，為羅弘信所襲，存信敗走，嗣源獨殿而還，太祖以嗣源所將騎五百號「橫沖都」。

translations.literal: Cunxin stayed at Shen County a long time and was attacked by Luo Hongxin. Cunxin was defeated and fled. Siyuan alone brought up the rear on the return. The Founding Sovereign named the five hundred horsemen Siyuan commanded the “Traverse Charge Command.”
translations.idiomatic: Cunxin lingered too long at Shen and Luo Hongxin fell on him. Cunxin ran. Siyuan alone covered the retreat. Keyong took the five hundred riders under Siyuan’s command and titled them the Traverse Charge Command.

sentences.zh: 光化三年，李嗣昭攻梁邢、洺，出青山，遇葛從周兵，嗣昭大敗走，梁兵追之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guanghua, Li Sizhao attacked Liang’s Xing and Ming prefectures, came out through Green Mountain, and encountered Ge Congzhou’s army. Sizhao was greatly defeated and fled; Liang troops pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In Guanghua 3 (900), Li Sizhao marched against Liang’s Xing and Ming and debouched through Green Mountain into Ge Congzhou’s host. Sizhao was routed and fled; Liang gave chase.

sentences.zh: 嗣源從間道後至，謂嗣昭曰：「為公一戰。

translations.literal: Siyuan came by a bypath to the rear and said to Sizhao: “I will fight one battle for you.
translations.idiomatic: Siyuan reached the field by a side road and told Sizhao, “Let me stand one fight for you.

sentences.zh: 」乃解鞍礪鏃，憑高為陣，左右指畫，梁追兵望之莫測。

translations.literal: ” He thereupon removed saddle and sharpened arrowheads, took the high ground and formed battle lines, and gestured left and right; the pursuing Liang troops gazed on them and could not fathom them.
translations.idiomatic: ” He stripped saddle, honed points, and drew up on the heights, signaling this way and that. The Liang pursuers stared and could not tell what they faced.

sentences.zh: 嗣源急呼曰：「吾取葛公，士卒可無動！

translations.literal: Siyuan urgently shouted: “I will take Lord Ge—soldiers, do not stir!
translations.idiomatic: Siyuan cried out, “I mean to seize Lord Ge myself—men, hold your ranks!

sentences.zh: 」乃馳騎犯之，出入奮擊。

translations.literal: ” He then galloped in and struck through them, charging in and out with fury.
translations.idiomatic: ” and spurred straight into the press, wheeling through the enemy lines again and again.

sentences.zh: 嗣昭繼進，梁兵解去。

translations.literal: Sizhao followed in attack; the Liang army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhao pressed after him; Liang drew off.

sentences.zh: 嗣源身中四矢，太祖解衣賜藥以勞之，由是李橫沖名重四方。

translations.literal: Siyuan took four arrows in his body. The Founding Sovereign removed his own garment and gave medicine to reward him. Thereupon Li the Traverse Charge’s name weighed heavy in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Four shafts lodged in Siyuan’s flesh. Keyong stripped his own coat and sent medicine to comfort him. From that day the name of Li the Traverse Charge rang through the realm.

sentences.zh: 梁、晉相拒於柏鄉，梁龍驤軍以赤、白馬為兩陣，旗幟鎧仗皆如馬色，晉兵望之皆懼。

translations.literal: Liang and Jin faced each other at Baixiang. Liang’s Dragon Soar army arrayed red and white horses as two formations; banners, armor, and weapons all matched the horses’ colors. Jin troops gazed on them and all feared.
translations.idiomatic: Liang and Jin stood opposed at Baixiang. Liang’s Dragon Soar corps split red horses and white horses into two wings; flags, mail, and gear were dyed to match. Jin soldiers looked on and quailed.

sentences.zh: 莊宗舉鐘以飲嗣源曰：「卿望梁家赤、白馬懼乎？

translations.literal: Zhuangzong raised a goblet and offered drink to Siyuan, saying: “Do you fear when you look on Liang’s red and white horses?
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong lifted a cup to Siyuan and said, “Do those red and white horses of Liang frighten you?

sentences.zh: 雖吾亦怯也。

translations.literal: Even I am afraid.
translations.idiomatic: I am afraid myself.

sentences.zh: 」嗣源笑曰：「有其表爾，翌日歸吾廄也。

translations.literal: ” Siyuan laughed and said: “They are only for show—tomorrow they will be in our stables.
translations.idiomatic: ” Siyuan laughed. “They are show only. Tomorrow they graze in our stables.

sentences.zh: 」莊宗大喜曰：「卿當以氣吞之。

translations.literal: ” Zhuangzong was greatly pleased and said: “You should swallow them with your spirit.
translations.idiomatic: ” Zhuangzong was delighted. “Then take them by sheer nerve.

sentences.zh: 」因引鐘飲酹，奮楇馳騎，犯其白馬，挾二裨將而還。

translations.literal: ” He thereupon took up the goblet, poured a libation, seized spear and galloped, charged the white horses, and seized two subordinate generals before returning.
translations.idiomatic: ” He drained the cup as offering, seized his lance, and charged the white wing, snatching two Liang officers before wheeling back.

sentences.zh: 梁兵敗，以功拜代州刺史。

translations.literal: The Liang army was defeated; by merit he was appointed governor of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Liang was beaten. For his service he was made governor of Dai.

sentences.zh: 莊宗攻劉守光，嗣源及李嗣昭將兵三萬別出飛狐，定山後，取武、媯、儒三州。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong attacked Liu Shouguang. Siyuan and Li Sizhao led thirty thousand men separately out through Flying Fox, pacified the lands beyond the passes, and took Wu, Ji, and Ru prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong moved on Liu Shouguang, Siyuan and Li Sizhao took thirty thousand men out by Flying Fox, settled the country north of the passes, and seized Wu, Ji, and Ru.

sentences.zh: 莊宗已平魏州，因徇下磁、相，拜相州刺史、昭德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong had already pacified Weizhou and thereupon marched down through Ci and Xiang. He appointed Siyuan governor of Xiangzhou and military governor of the Zhaode army.
translations.idiomatic: After Weizhou fell Zhuangzong swept on through Ci and Xiang. He made Siyuan governor of Xiang and military governor of Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 久之，徙鎮安國。

translations.literal: After a long while he was transferred to govern the Anguo circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In time he was shifted to the Anguo command.

sentences.zh: 契丹攻幽州，莊宗遣嗣源與閻寶等擊走之。

translations.literal: The Khitan attacked Youzhou. Zhuangzong sent Siyuan with Yan Bao and others to strike and drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan raiders hit Youzhou. Zhuangzong sent Siyuan with Yan Bao and others to beat them back.

sentences.zh: 同光元年，徙鎮橫海。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongguang he was transferred to govern the Henghai circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang 1 (923) he was moved to the Henghai command.

sentences.zh: 是時，梁、唐相拒於河上，李繼韜以潞州叛降梁，莊宗有憂色，召嗣源帳中，謂曰：「繼韜以上黨降梁，而梁方急攻澤州，吾出不意襲鄆州，以斷梁右臂，可乎？

translations.literal: At that time Liang and Tang faced each other on the Yellow River. Li Jiyao rebelled at Luzhou and surrendered to Liang. Zhuangzong wore a troubled look. He summoned Siyuan into his tent and said: “Jiyao has surrendered Shangdang to Liang, and Liang is pressing the attack on Ze Prefecture. If we strike Yan Prefecture by surprise and sever Liang’s right arm, can it be done?
translations.idiomatic: Liang and Tang were locked along the Yellow River. Li Jiyao turned Luzhou over to Liang. Zhuangzong’s face darkened. He called Siyuan to his tent and said, “Jiyao has given Shangdang to Liang while they hammer Ze. Suppose we take Yan by surprise and cut Liang’s right arm—would that serve?

sentences.zh: 」嗣源對曰：「夾河之兵久矣，茍非出奇，則大計不決，臣請獨當之。

translations.literal: ” Siyuan replied: “The armies on both banks have faced each other too long. Unless we do something unexpected the great plan will not be settled. I ask to bear this alone.
translations.idiomatic: ” Siyuan answered, “The river armies have stared at each other for years. Nothing decisive will come without a surprise. Let me carry this alone.

sentences.zh: 」乃以步騎五千涉濟，至鄆州，鄆人無備，遂襲破之，即拜天平軍節度使、蕃漢馬步軍副都總管。

translations.literal: ” He thereupon forded the Ji with five thousand foot and horse, reached Yan Prefecture—Yan was unprepared—and stormed and broke it. He was at once appointed military governor of the Tianping army and deputy overall commander of Tangut-Han horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: ” With five thousand mixed horse and foot he crossed the Ji, reached Yan unawares, and took the city by assault. He was made military governor of Tianping and deputy commander of all Tangut and Han horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 梁軍攻破德勝南柵，莊宗退保楊劉。

translations.literal: Liang troops broke through the southern stockade at Desheng. Zhuangzong withdrew to defend Yangliu.
translations.idiomatic: Liang breached the southern palisade at Desheng. Zhuangzong fell back to Yangliu.

sentences.zh: 王彥章急攻鄆州，莊宗悉軍救之，嗣源為前鋒，擊梁軍。

translations.literal: Wang Yanzhang pressed the attack on Yan Prefecture. Zhuangzong led out the whole army to rescue it. Siyuan was vanguard and struck Liang’s army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanzhang hammered Yan. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.

sentences.zh: 追至中都，擒彥章及梁監軍張漢傑。

translations.literal: Pursuit reached Zhongdu; Yanzhang and Liang army inspector Zhang Hanjie were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The chase ran to Zhongdu. Yanzhang and Liang inspector Zhang Hanjie were taken.

sentences.zh: 彥章雖敗，而段凝悉將梁兵屯河上，莊宗未知所向，諸將多言乘勝以取青、齊，嗣源曰：「彥章之敗，凝猶未知，使其聞之，遲疑定計，亦須三日。

translations.literal: Though Yanzhang had been defeated, Duan Ning still held all Liang’s troops on the river. Zhuangzong did not know where to turn. Many generals urged taking advantage of victory to seize Qing and Qi. Siyuan said: “Yanzhang’s defeat—Ning does not yet know of it. If he hears, he will hesitate and fix a plan; that too will take three days.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhang was down, but Duan Ning still had every Liang soldier on the river. Zhuangzong could not choose a course. Officers urged pressing on to Qing and Qi. Siyuan said, “Ning has not heard of Yanzhang’s fall. When he does he will stall and reckon—that buys three days.

sentences.zh: 縱使料吾所向，亟發救兵，必渡黎陽，數萬之眾，舟楫非一日具也。

translations.literal: Even if he guesses where we mean to go and hurries relief, he must cross Liyang; tens of thousands cannot be ferried in a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Even if he guesses our aim and rushes help, he must cross at Liyang. Tens of thousands cannot be boated across in one day.

sentences.zh: 此去汴州，不數百里，前無險阻，方陣而行，信宿可至，汴州已破，段凝豈足顧哉！

translations.literal: From here to Bianzhou is not several hundred li, with no barrier ahead; marching in battle formation we can arrive in two nights. Once Bianzhou is broken, what is Duan Ning to worry about!
translations.idiomatic: Bian lies fewer than two hundred li ahead with no choke point between. In battle order we reach it in two marches. Bian falls—then who cares for Duan Ning?

sentences.zh: 」而郭崇韜亦勸莊宗入汴，莊宗以為然，遣嗣源以千騎先至汴州，攻封丘門，王瓚開門降。

translations.literal: ” Guo Chongtao also urged Zhuangzong to enter Bian. Zhuangzong agreed and sent Siyuan with a thousand horse ahead to Bianzhou to attack the Fengqiu Gate. Wang Zan opened the gate and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: ” Guo Chongtao seconded the plan. Zhuangzong assented and sent Siyuan with a thousand riders to Bian to storm the Fengqiu Gate. Wang Zan opened and yielded.

sentences.zh: 莊宗後至，見嗣源大喜，手攬其衣，以頭觸之曰：「天下與爾共之。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong arrived afterward, saw Siyuan, and was greatly pleased. He took Siyuan’s garment in his hands and touched heads with him, saying: “The realm is yours and mine together.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong came after, saw Siyuan, and rejoiced. He seized his robe and pressed forehead to forehead. “The empire is yours and mine together.

sentences.zh: 」拜中書令。

translations.literal: ” He was appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: ” He was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二年，莊宗祀天南郊，賜以鐵券。

translations.literal: In the second year Zhuangzong sacrificed to Heaven at the southern suburb and granted him an iron certificate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Zhuangzong offered to Heaven at the southern suburb and gave him an iron certificate of mercy.

sentences.zh: 五月，破楊立於潞州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yang Li was broken at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yang Li was crushed at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，徙鎮宣武，兼蕃漢內外馬步軍總管。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was transferred to govern the Xuanwu circuit and concurrently made overall commander of Tangut-Han horse and foot within and without.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was shifted to Xuanwu and named overall commander of all Tangut and Han horse and foot, court and field.

sentences.zh: 冬，契丹侵漁陽，嗣源敗之於涿州。

translations.literal: In winter the Khitan raided Yuyang. Siyuan defeated them at Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Khitan raiders struck Yuyang. Siyuan beat them at Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙鎮成德。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to govern the Chengde circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was moved to the Chengde command.

sentences.zh: 莊宗幸鄴，請朝行在，不許。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong visited Ye. Siyuan asked to attend at the traveling palace; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong went to Ye. Siyuan asked leave to attend at the traveling palace and was refused.

sentences.zh: 貞簡太后疾，請入省，又不許。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Zhenjian fell ill. He asked to enter and visit her; again permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Zhenjian lay ill. He asked to visit her within the palace and was refused again.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，請赴山陵，許之，而契丹侵邊，乃止。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died he asked to attend the mountain tomb; permission was granted, but Khitan raided the border and the journey was halted.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died he sought leave for the tomb. Leave was granted, but Khitan struck the frontier and he stayed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遂朝於洛陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he at last had audience at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was finally received at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 天成元年，郭崇韜、朱友謙皆以讒死，嗣源以名位高，亦見疑忌。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng, Guo Chongtao and Zhu Youqian both died through slander. Siyuan, because his name and rank were high, was also viewed with suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancheng 1 (926) Guo Chongtao and Zhu Youqian fell to calumny. Siyuan’s standing made him suspect as well.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮反於魏，大臣皆請遣嗣源討賊，莊宗不許。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili rebelled at Wei. The great ministers all asked that Siyuan be sent to suppress the bandits. Zhuangzong would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili rose at Wei. Ministers begged Zhuangzong to send Siyuan against him. Zhuangzong refused.

sentences.zh: 群臣屢請，莊宗不得已，遣之。

translations.literal: The courtiers pleaded again and again. Zhuangzong had no choice and sent him.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed repeatedly until Zhuangzong yielded and dispatched him.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，嗣源至魏，屯御河南，在禮登樓謝罪。

translations.literal: On the third month, day renzi, Siyuan reached Wei and encamped south of the imperial ford. Zaili ascended the tower and begged pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the third month Siyuan reached Wei and camped south of the imperial ford. Zaili climbed the wall and sued for mercy.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，軍變，嗣源入於魏，與在禮合，夕出，止魏縣。

translations.literal: On jiayin the army mutinied. Siyuan entered Wei and joined Zaili. That evening he marched out and halted at Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the troops mutinied. Siyuan entered Wei and threw in with Zaili. At dusk he marched out and stopped at Wei County.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以其兵南，遣石敬瑭將三百騎為先鋒。

translations.literal: On dingsi he led his army south and sent Shi Jingtang with three hundred horse as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he turned south with the host and sent Shi Jingtang ahead with three hundred riders.

sentences.zh: 嗣源行過鉅鹿，掠小坊馬二千匹以益軍。

translations.literal: As Siyuan marched past Julu he plundered two thousand horses from the small stockades to strengthen the army.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Julu he stripped two thousand horses from the roadside hamlets to swell his columns.

sentences.zh: 壬申，入汴州。

translations.literal: On renshen he entered Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he entered Bian.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，太子賓客鄭玨、工部尚書任圜為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, bingchen, Guest of the Heir Apparent Zheng Jue and Minister of Works Ren Huan were made Vice Directors of the Department of State Affairs and Co-Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month, Zheng Jue, guest of the heir apparent, and Ren Huan, minister of works, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，趙在禮為義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Zhao Zaili was made military governor of the Yicheng army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhao Zaili was made military governor of Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，汴州控鶴軍亂，指揮使張諫殺其權知州事高逖。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the sixth month the Crane Control army at Bianzhou mutinied. Commander Zhang Jian killed Gao Di, who was acting prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the sixth month the Crane Control garrison at Bian mutinied. Commander Zhang Jian killed Gao Di, acting prefect.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諫伏誅。

translations.literal: On jihai Jian was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Jian was put to death.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，安重誨殺殿直馬延於御史臺門。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day gengshen, An Chonghui killed palace attendant Ma Yan at the gate of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the seventh month An Chonghui had palace attendant Ma Yan killed at the Censorate gate.

sentences.zh: 契丹使梅老述骨來，渤海使大昭佐來。

translations.literal: Khitan envoy Mei Laoshugu came; Bohai envoy Da Zhaozuo came.
translations.idiomatic: A Khitan envoy, Mei Laoshugu, arrived; a Bohai envoy, Da Zhaozuo, arrived.

sentences.zh: 己卯，貶豆盧革為辰州刺史，韋說敘州刺史。

translations.literal: On jimao Dou Lu Ge was demoted to prefect of Chen Prefecture and Wei Shuo to prefect of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Dou Lu Ge was demoted to prefect of Chen and Wei Shuo to prefect of Xu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，流革於陵州，說於合州。

translations.literal: On jiashen Ge was banished to Ling Prefecture and Shuo to He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Ge was exiled to Ling and Shuo to He.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉朔，陜州硤石縣民高存妻一產三男子。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, yiyou, Gao Cun’s wife in Xiashi County, Shaan Prefecture, bore three sons in one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the eighth month, the wife of Gao Cun in Xiashi, Shaan, gave birth to three boys at once.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以象笏三十二賜百官之無笏者。

translations.literal: On dingyou thirty-two ivory court tablets were granted to officials who had none.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou thirty-two ivory court tablets were given to officials who lacked them.

sentences.zh: 閱稼於冷泉宮。

translations.literal: He inspected the crops at Cold Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inspected the harvest at Cold Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，契丹寇邊。

translations.literal: On jihai Khitan raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Khitan struck the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁未，平盧軍節度使霍彥威殺其登州刺史王公儼。

translations.literal: On dingwei Huo Yanwei, military governor of the Pinglu army, killed Wang Gongyi, his prefect of Deng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Huo Yanwei, military governor of Pinglu, killed his Deng prefect Wang Gongyi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，醫官張誌忠為太原少尹。

translations.literal: On jiayin the medical officer Zhang Zhizhong was made vice governor of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the physician Zhang Zhizhong was made vice governor of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，幸至德宮及袁建豐第。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the ninth month the emperor visited Perfect Virtue Palace and Yuan Jianfeng’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the ninth month he visited Perfect Virtue Palace and Yuan Jianfeng’s house.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，雲南山後兩林百蠻都鬼主、右武衛大將軍李卑晚使大鬼主傅能何華來。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the tenth month, Li Beiwan, chief demon lord of the Two Forests Hundred Clans south of Cloud Mountain and great general of the Right Martial Guard, sent the great demon lord Fu Nenghua as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the tenth month, Li Beiwan, chief spirit lord of the Two Forests Hundred Clans south of Cloud Mountain and great general of the Right Martial Guard, sent the great spirit lord Fu Nenghua as envoy.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，契丹使沒骨餒來告阿保機哀，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Khitan envoy Mogunei came to announce mourning for Abaoji. Court audience was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Khitan envoy Mogunei came with word of Abaoji’s death. The court mourned three days.

sentences.zh: 旱，辛亥雨。

translations.literal: There was drought; on xinhai it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Drought held the land; on xinhai rain fell.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸丑朔，更名亶。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the guichou new moon, he changed his personal name to Dan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, on the guichou new moon of the first month, he changed his personal name to Dan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，端明殿學士兵部侍郎馮道、太常卿崔協為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On guihai Feng Dao, academician of the Bright Hall and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, grand master of splendid happiness, were made Vice Directors of the Department of State Affairs and Co-Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Feng Dao, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, grand master of splendid happiness, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午朔，新羅使張芬來。

translations.literal: On the renwu new moon of the second month, Silla envoy Zhang Fen came.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the second month the Silla envoy Zhang Fen arrived.

sentences.zh: 西川節度使孟知祥殺其兵馬都監李嚴。

translations.literal: Meng Zhixiang, military governor of the Western Shu circuit, killed his horse-and-foot inspector Li Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang, military governor of Western Shu, killed his inspector of horse and foot, Li Yan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，赦京師囚。

translations.literal: On bingchen prisoners in the capital were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen prisoners in the capital were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 郭從謙為景州刺史，既而殺之。

translations.literal: Guo Congqian was made prefect of Jing; afterward he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Congqian was made prefect of Jing—and soon after was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，山南東道節度使劉訓為南面招討使，以伐荊南。

translations.literal: On wuxu Liu Xun, military governor of the Shannan East circuit, was made southern campaign suppression commissioner to attack Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Liu Xun, military governor of Shannan East, was named southern suppression commissioner to strike Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，幸會節園，群臣買宴。

translations.literal: On the renzi new moon of the third month the emperor visited Festival Garden; the assembled ministers were feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the third month he went to Festival Garden and gave a feast for the court.

sentences.zh: 盧臺軍亂，殺其將寫震。

translations.literal: The Lutai army mutinied and killed its general Wu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: The Lutai garrison mutinied and killed its commander Wu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 新羅使林彥來。

translations.literal: Silla envoy Lin Yan came.
translations.idiomatic: The Silla envoy Lin Yan arrived.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，盧臺軍將龍至等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Lutai officers Long Zhi and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fourth month of summer, Lutai officers Long Zhi and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，盧臺軍將龍至等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Lutai officers Long Zhi and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fourth month of summer, Lutai officers Long Zhi and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，任圜罷。

translations.literal: On bingxu Ren Huan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ren Huan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸白司馬坡，祭突厥神。

translations.literal: On gengzi the emperor visited White Horse Slope and sacrificed to the Turkic spirit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he went to White Horse Slope and offered to the Turkic spirit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，隨州刺史西方鄴取夔、忠、萬州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiazi, Western Fang Ye, prefect of Sui, took Kui, Zhong, and Wan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the seventh month Fang Ye of the west, prefect of Sui, seized Kui, Zhong, and Wan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，殺豆盧革、韋說。

translations.literal: On guiyou Dou Lu Ge and Wei Shuo were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Dou Lu Ge and Wei Shuo were executed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，牂牁使宋朝化及昆明使者來。

translations.literal: On yiyou envoys came from Zangge and from Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou envoys arrived from Zangge and from Kunming.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，党項使如連山來。

translations.literal: On gengwu Tangut envoys came by way of Lianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Tangut envoys came through Lianshan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，契丹使梅老來。

translations.literal: On renshen the Khitan envoy Mei Lao arrived at court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Khitan envoy Mei Lao came.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，如汴州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on yiyou, he went to Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the tenth month he went to Bian.

sentences.zh: 宣武軍節度使朱守殷反，馬步軍都指揮使馬彥超死之。

translations.literal: Zhu Shouyin, military governor of the Xuanwu army, rebelled. Ma Yanchao, overall commander of horse and foot, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shouyin, military governor of Xuanwu, rose in revolt. Ma Yanchao, overall commander of horse and foot, fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 己丑，守殷自殺。

translations.literal: On jichou Shouyin killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Shouyin took his own life.

sentences.zh: 乙未，殺太子少保致仕任圜。

translations.literal: On yiwei Ren Huan, retired grand guardian of the heir apparent, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Ren Huan, retired grand guardian of the heir apparent, was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，德音釋輕系囚。

translations.literal: On xinchou a gracious edict released prisoners held on light charges.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a mercy edict freed prisoners held on lesser offenses.

sentences.zh: 是月，傳箭於霍彥威。

translations.literal: That month an arrow summons was sent to Huo Yanwei.
translations.idiomatic: That month a summoning arrow was sent to Huo Yanwei.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，契丹使梅老來。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yihai, the Khitan envoy Mei Lao came.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the eleventh month the Khitan envoy Mei Lao came.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，回鶻西界吐蕃遣使者來。

translations.literal: On jichou envoys came from the Uyghur western frontier and from Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou envoys arrived from the Uyghur western marches and from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，畋於東郊。

translations.literal: On jiachen the emperor went hunting at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙午，追尊祖考為皇帝，妣為皇后；

translations.literal: On bingwu he posthumously honored his grandfather as emperor and his grandmother as empress;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he posthumously raised his grandfather to emperor and his grandmother to empress;

sentences.zh: 高祖聿謚曰孝恭，廟號惠祖，祖妣劉氏謚曰孝恭昭；

translations.literal: The High Ancestor was posthumously titled Xiaogong, with temple name Huizu; the paternal grandmother, the Liu clan, was posthumously titled Xiaogong Zhao;
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor received the posthumous name Xiaogong and the temple title Huizu; his consort, Lady Liu, the name Xiaogong Zhao;

sentences.zh: 曾祖敖謚曰孝質，廟號毅祖，祖妣張氏謚曰孝質順；

translations.literal: the great-grandfather Ao was posthumously titled Xiaozhi, with temple name Yizu; the paternal grandmother, the Zhang clan, was posthumously titled Xiaozhi Shun;
translations.idiomatic: great-grandfather Ao the posthumous Xiaozhi and temple name Yizu; his consort, Lady Zhang, Xiaozhi Shun;

sentences.zh: 祖琰謚曰孝靖，廟號烈祖，祖妣何氏謚曰孝靖穆；

translations.literal: the grandfather Yan was posthumously titled Xiaojing, with temple name Liezu; the paternal grandmother, the He clan, was posthumously titled Xiaojing Mu;
translations.idiomatic: grandfather Yan the posthumous Xiaojing and temple name Liezu; his consort, Lady He, Xiaojing Mu;

sentences.zh: 考謚曰孝成，廟號德祖，妣劉氏謚曰孝成懿。

translations.literal: the father was posthumously titled Xiaocheng, with temple name Dezu; the mother, the Liu clan, was posthumously titled Xiaocheng Yi.
translations.idiomatic: his father the posthumous Xiaocheng and temple name Dezu; his mother, Lady Liu, Xiaocheng Yi.

sentences.zh: 立廟於應州。

translations.literal: An ancestral temple was established at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A dynastic temple was raised at Ying.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳，契丹陷平州。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dingsi, Khitan took Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, on dingsi of the first month, Khitan seized Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，吐渾都督李紹虜來。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinsi, Tuhun commander Li Shaolu came.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the second month the Tuhun commander Li Shaolu arrived.

sentences.zh: 乙未，孔循罷。

translations.literal: On yimou Kong Xun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimou Kong Xun left office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，回鶻使李阿山來。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Uyghur envoy Li Ashan came.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Uyghur envoy Li Ashan came.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未朔，御劄求直言。

translations.literal: On the dingwei new moon of the third month an imperial rescript sought frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the third month the throne called for blunt counsel in an imperial rescript.

sentences.zh: 己未，鄭玨罷。

translations.literal: On jiwei Zheng Jue was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zheng Jue left office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，成德軍節度使王建立為尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On guihai Wang Jianli, military governor of the Chengde army, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Co-Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Wang Jianli, military governor of Chengde, became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 西方鄴克歸州。

translations.literal: Xifang Ye took Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xifang Ye seized Gui prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宣徽南院使範延光為樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Fan Yanguang, commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Fan Yanguang of the southern Secretariat bureau was named Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，延光罷。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on wuyin, Yanguang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fourth month, in summer, Yanguang left office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，達靼遣使者來。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Tatars sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Tatars sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 義武軍節度使王都反。

translations.literal: Wang Du, military governor of the Yiwu army, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Du, military governor of Yiwu, rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，歸德軍節度使王晏球為北面行營招討使。

translations.literal: On renyin Wang Yanqiu, military governor of the Guide army, was made northern campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Yanqiu, military governor of Guide, was made northern campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，契丹禿餒入於定州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Khitan Tuyi entered Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Khitan leader Tuyi entered Ding.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，右衛上將軍趙敬怡為樞密使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Zhao Jingyi, general of the Right Guard, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zhao Jingyi, general of the Right Guard, became Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 封回鶻可汁王仁裕為順化可汗。

translations.literal: The Uyghur kaghan Wang Renyu was enfeoffed as Shunhua Kaghan.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghur kaghan Wang Renyu was enfeoffed as Shunhua Kaghan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，殺齊州防禦使曹廷隱。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei, Cao Tingyin, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the seventh month, in autumn, Cao Tingyin, defense commissioner of Qi, was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月，盧龍軍節度使趙德鈞執契丹首領惕隱赫邈。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Zhao Dejun, military governor of the Lulong army, seized the Khitan leader, tiyin Hemi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhao Dejun of Lulong captured the Khitan tiyin Hemi.

sentences.zh: 慶州防禦使竇廷琬反。

translations.literal: Dou Tingwan, defense commissioner of Qingzhou, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Tingwan, defense commissioner of Qing, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，靜難軍節度使李敬周討之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Li Jingzhou, military governor of the Jingnan army, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan, marched against him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，突厥使張慕晉來。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Turk envoy Zhang Mujin came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Turk envoy Zhang Mujin came.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，吐渾使念九來。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, the Tuhun envoy Nianjiu came.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the eleventh month the Tuhun envoy Nianjiu came.

sentences.zh: 甲午，王建立罷。

translations.literal: On jiawu Wang Jianli was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Jianli left office.

sentences.zh: 十二月，李敬周克慶州，竇廷琬伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Li Jingzhou took Qingzhou; Dou Tingwan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Jingzhou took Qing; Dou Tingwan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 幸亥，幸康義誠第。

translations.literal: On xinhai he visited Kang Yicheng’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he called at Kang Yicheng’s house.

sentences.zh: 長興元年春正月丁卯，閱馬於苑。

translations.literal: In Changxing year 1, spring, first month, on dingmao, he reviewed horses in the park.
translations.idiomatic: In Changxing 1 (930), spring, on dingmao of the first month, he reviewed horses in the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宣徽南院使朱弘昭為大內留守。

translations.literal: On xinmao Zhu Hongzhao, commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made grand inner palace custodian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhu Hongzhao of the southern Secretariat bureau was made grand custodian of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 二月，戊戌，黑水兀兒遣使者來。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuxu, Heishui Wuer sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the second month Heishui Wuer sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天雄軍節度使石敬瑭為御營使。

translations.literal: On yisi Shi Jingtang, military governor of the Tianxiong army, was made imperial camp commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Shi Jingtang, military governor of Tianxiong, was made imperial camp commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，朝獻於太微宮。

translations.literal: On guichou he offered tribute at the Grand Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he made offering at the Grand Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiayin he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he sacrificed at the dynastic temple.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，有事於南郊，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On yimao he performed the suburban rites, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he worshipped at the southern suburb, declared a great amnesty, and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，立淑妃曹氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, Consort Cao was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the third month Consort Cao was raised to empress.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，安重誨使河中衙內指揮使楊彥溫逐其節度使從珂。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on wuxu, An Chonghui had Yang Yanwen, garrison commander at Hezhong, expel its military governor Congke.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the fourth month, in summer, An Chonghui had Yang Yanwen, Hezhong garrison commander, drive out the circuit’s military governor Congke.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，西京留守索自通、侍衛步軍指揮使藥彥稠討之。

translations.literal: On renyin Suo Zitong, western capital custodian, and Yao Yanchou, commander of the palace foot army, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Suo Zitong, custodian of the western capital, and Yao Yanchou, commander of the palace foot soldiery, marched against him.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，自通執彥溫殺之。

translations.literal: On xinhai Zitong seized Yanwen and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zitong seized Yanwen and executed him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，群臣上尊號曰聖明神武文德恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On wuwu the ministers presented the honorific title Sagacious, Luminous, Divine, Martial, Civil, Virtuous, Reverent, and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the ministers offered the honorific Sagacious, Luminous, Divine, Martial, Civil, Virtuous, Reverent, and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，吐蕃首領於撥葛來。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Tibetan leader Yuboge came.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Tibetan leader Yuboge came.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，回鶻使孽栗祖來。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingchou, the Uyghur envoy Nielizu came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fifth month the Uyghur envoy Nielizu came.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，回鶻使安黑連來。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Uyghur envoy An Heilian came.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Uyghur envoy An Heilian came.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，訪莊宗子孫瘞所。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on renwu, he sought the burial place of Zhuangzong’s descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the seventh month, in autumn, he searched out where Zhuangzong’s line lay buried.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，忠武軍節度使張延朗為三司使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei, Zhang Yanlang, military governor of the Zhongwu army, was made Three Commissions commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the eighth month Zhang Yanlang, military governor of Zhongwu, was made Three Commissions commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，殺捧聖都軍使李行德、大將張儉，滅其族。

translations.literal: On renyin Li Xingde, commander of the Paladin Capital Guard, and the general Zhang Jian were killed and their clans extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Li Xingde, commander of the Paladin Capital Guard, and the general Zhang Jian were executed and their kin wiped out.

sentences.zh: 吐渾來附。

translations.literal: Tuhun came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuhun submitted.

sentences.zh: 封子從榮為秦王。

translations.literal: His son Congrong was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: His son Congrong was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 戊申，海州將王傳極殺其刺史陳宣，叛於吳來降。

translations.literal: On wushen Wang Chuanji, a general of Haizhou, killed its prefect Chen Xuan, rebelled in Wu, and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wang Chuanji, a Haizhou officer, killed the prefect Chen Xuan, had thrown in with Wu, and now came over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，吐渾康合畢來。

translations.literal: On yimao the Tuhun Kang Hebi came.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Tuhun leader Kang Hebi came.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，封子從厚為宋王。

translations.literal: On bingchen his son Conghou was enfeoffed as Prince of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen his son Conghou was enfeoffed as Prince of Song.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，吐蕃使王滿儒來。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu, the Tibetan envoy Wang Manru came.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the ninth month the Tibetan envoy Wang Manru came.

sentences.zh: 東川節度使董璋反。

translations.literal: Dong Zhang, military governor of Dongchuan, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhang, military governor of Dongchuan, rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 甲申，成德軍節度使範延光為樞密使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Fan Yanguang, military governor of the Chengde army, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Fan Yanguang, military governor of Chengde, became Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，石敬瑭為東川行營都招討使。

translations.literal: On dinghai Shi Jingtang was made grand suppression commissioner of the eastern Sichuan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Shi Jingtang was made grand suppression commissioner for the eastern Sichuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，始藏冰。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingyou, ice was first stored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the tenth month, in winter, the court began the rite of storing ice.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，驍衛上將軍致仕張筠進助軍粟。

translations.literal: On jiachen Zhang Yun, retired general of the Valiant Guard, presented grain to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Yun, retired general of the Valiant Guard, sent grain to support the troops.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，董璋陷閬州，殺節度使李仁矩，指揮使姚洪死之。

translations.literal: On yisi Dong Zhang took Langzhou, killed the military governor Li Renju, and the commander Yao Hong died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Dong Zhang seized Lang, killed the military governor Li Renju, and the commander Yao Hong fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 孟知祥反。

translations.literal: Meng Zhixiang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申朔，秦王從榮受冊，謁於太廟。

translations.literal: On the gengshen new moon of the eleventh month the Prince of Qin Congrong received investiture and paid homage at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the eleventh month Prince of Qin Congrong took the seal and bowed at the dynastic temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，契丹東丹王突欲來奔。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Khitan Prince of Eastern Dān, Tuyu, fled to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Khitan Prince of Eastern Dān, Tuyu, defected to the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，二王後、秘書丞、酅國公楊仁矩卒，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, Yang Renju, heir to the two kings, secretary aide, and Duke of Xi, died; the court mourned one day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the twelfth month Yang Renju, heir of the two royal houses, secretary aide, and Duke of Xi, died; court business ceased one day.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，回鶻順化可汗王仁裕使翟末斯來。

translations.literal: On dingsi Zhai Mosi came as envoy of Wang Renyu, Shunhua Kaghan of the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhai Mosi arrived as envoy from the Uyghur Shunhua Kaghan Wang Renyu.

sentences.zh: 安重誨討董璋。

translations.literal: An Chonghui campaigned against Dong Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui marched against Dong Zhang.

sentences.zh: 沙州曹義金遣使者來。

translations.literal: Cao Yijin of Shazhou sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yijin of Shazhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊辰，党項使折七移來。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on wuchen, the Tangut envoy Zheqiyi came.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, on wuchen of the first month, the Tangut envoy Zheqiyi came.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，達靼使列六薛娘居來。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Tatar envoy Lieliuxueniangju came.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Tatar envoy Lieliuxueniangju came.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，幸安元信第。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingyou, he visited An Yuanxin’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the second month he called at An Yuanxin’s house.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，突厥使杜阿熟、吐渾使康萬琳來。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Turk envoy Du Ashu and the Tuhun envoy Kang Wanlin came.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Turk envoy Du Ashu and the Tuhun envoy Kang Wanlin came.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，安重誨罷。

translations.literal: On xinchou An Chonghui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou An Chonghui left office.

sentences.zh: 三月，趙鳳罷。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhao Feng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhao Feng left office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太常卿李愚為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On dinghai Li Yu, grand minister of imperial sacrifices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Yu, grand minister of imperial sacrifices, became Vice Director of the Secretariat and co-grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，宣徽北院使趙延壽為樞密使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiachen, Zhao Yanshou, commissioner of the northern bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the fourth month, in summer, Zhao Yanshou of the northern Secretariat bureau was named Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，董璋陷遂州，武信軍節度使夏魯奇死之。

translations.literal: On jiayin Dong Zhang took Suizhou; Xia Luqi, military governor of the Wuxin army, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Dong Zhang seized Sui; Xia Luqi, military governor of Wuxin, fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以旱赦流罪以下囚。

translations.literal: On yimao, owing to drought, prisoners below exile offense were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, because of drought, prisoners convicted below exile were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丁酉，殺太子太師致仕安重誨及其妻張氏、子崇贊崇緒。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, on dingyou, the retired grand preceptor of the heir apparent An Chonghui, his wife the Zhang clan, and his sons Chongzan and Chongxu were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the intercalary fifth month the retired grand preceptor of the heir An Chonghui, his wife Lady Zhang, and his sons Chongzan and Chongxu were put to death.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己未，契丹使邪姑兒來。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on jiwei, the Khitan envoy Yeguer came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the eighth month, in autumn, the Khitan envoy Yeguer came.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，放五坊鷹隼。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, hawks and falcons of the Five Pens were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the ninth month the court freed the hawks and falcons of the Five Pens.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊申，吐蕃遣使者來。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on wushen, Tibet sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the eleventh month, in winter, Tibet sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，旌表棣州民邢釗門閭。

translations.literal: On xinchou the household of Xing Zhao of Dizhou was honored at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court honored the household of Xing Zhao of Di at his gate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅朔，除鐵禁，初稅農具錢。

translations.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month the iron monopoly was lifted and a tax on farm-tool coin was first levied.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month the iron ban was lifted and a levy on farm implements was first imposed.

sentences.zh: 己未，西涼府遣使者來。

translations.literal: On jiwei Xiliang prefecture sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Xiliang sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 己巳，回鶻使安永思來。

translations.literal: On jisi the Uyghur envoy An Yongsi came.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Uyghur envoy An Yongsi came.

sentences.zh: 辛未，渤海使文成角來。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Parhae envoy Wenchengjiao came.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Parhae envoy Wenchengjiao came.

sentences.zh: 党項寇方渠。

translations.literal: Tangut raided Fangqu.
translations.idiomatic: Tangut struck Fangqu.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，契丹使拽骨來。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengzi, the Khitan envoy Zhuaiyu came.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, on gengzi of the first month, the Khitan envoy Zhuaiyu came.

sentences.zh: 己酉，渤海、回鶻皆遣使者來。

translations.literal: On jiyou both Parhae and the Uyghurs sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Parhae and the Uyghurs each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，靜難軍節度使藥彥稠及党項戰於牛兒谷，敗之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jimao, Yao Yanchou, military governor of the Jingnan army, fought the Tangut at Ox Valley and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the second month Yao Yanchou of Jingnan fought the Tangut at Ox Valley and beat them.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，契丹遣使者來。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiashen, Khitan sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the third month Khitan sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，新羅遣使者來。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengshen, Silla sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the fourth month, in summer, Silla sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，二王後詹事司直楊延紹襲封酅國公。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jichou, Yang Yanshao, heir-apparent household aide, succeeded as Duke of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the fifth month Yang Yanshao, aide in the heir’s household, inherited the title Duke of Xi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，孟知祥攻董璋，陷綿州。

translations.literal: On bingwu Meng Zhixiang attacked Dong Zhang and took Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Meng Zhixiang struck Dong Zhang and seized Mian.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，封王建為高麗國王、大義軍使孟知祥殺董璋，陷東川。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiayin, Wang Jian was enfeoffed as King of Goryeo; Meng Zhixiang, commissioner of the Dayi army, killed Dong Zhang and took eastern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the sixth month Wang Jian was enfeoffed king of Goryeo; Meng Zhixiang, commissioner of the Dayi army, killed Dong Zhang and took Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 達靼首領頡哥以其族來附。

translations.literal: The Tatar leader Ge brought his clan to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Tatar leader Ge led his people in submission.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己卯，吐蕃遣使者來。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on jimao, Tibet sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the eighth month, in autumn, Tibet sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，幸石敬瑭第。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengshen, he visited Shi Jingtang’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the tenth month, in winter, he called at Shi Jingtang’s house.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚寅，端明殿學士、兵部侍郎劉句為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengyin, Liu Gou, academician of the Bright Hall and vice minister of war, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, on gengyin of the first month, Liu Gou, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, became Vice Director of the Secretariat and co-grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，孟知祥使朱滉來。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuwu, Meng Zhixiang’s envoy Zhu Huang came.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the second month Meng Zhixiang’s envoy Zhu Huang came.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，追冊晉國夫人夏氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen, Lady Xia, Jin State Consort, was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the third month Lady Xia, consort of Jin, was posthumously raised to empress.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，封子從珂為潞王，從益許王，侄從溫兗王，從璋洋王，從敏涇王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on wuyin, his son Congke was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu, Congyi as Prince of Xu, his nephew Congwen as Prince of Yan, Congzhang as Prince of Yang, and Congmin as Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fifth month, in summer, his son Congke was made Prince of Lu, Congyi Prince of Xu, his nephew Congwen Prince of Yan, Congzhang Prince of Yang, and Congmin Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，契丹使述骨卿來。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Khitan envoy Shugujing came.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Khitan envoy Shugujing arrived.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，回鶻都督李末來，獻白鶻，命放之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yiwei, Uyghur commander Li Mo came and presented a white crane; he was ordered to release it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the seventh month, in autumn, the Uyghur commander Li Mo came, offering a white crane; the court ordered it set free.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wushen, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the eighth month the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，趙延壽罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuxu, Zhao Yanshou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the ninth month Zhao Yanshou left office.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度使朱弘昭為樞密使。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao, military governor of the Shannan East Circuit, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao, military governor of Shannan East, became Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，範延光罷。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengshen, Fan Yanguang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the tenth month, in winter, Fan Yanguang left office.

sentences.zh: 三司使馮赟為樞密使。

translations.literal: Feng Yun, commissioner of the Three Offices, was made Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun, Three Offices commissioner, was named Bureau Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸士和亭，得疾。

translations.literal: On renshen he visited Shihe Pavilion and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he went to Shihe Pavilion and took sick.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，秦王從榮以兵入興聖宮，不克，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, the Prince of Qin Congrong led troops into Xingsheng Palace, failed, and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the eleventh month Prince of Qin Congrong marched on Xingsheng Palace, could not prevail, and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，侍衛親軍都指揮使康義誠殺三司使孫嶽。

translations.literal: On yiwei Kang Yicheng, commander-in-chief of the Palace Attendant Personal Army, killed Sun Yue, commissioner of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Kang Yicheng, commander of the Palace Attendant Personal Army, killed Sun Yue, Three Offices commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，皇帝崩於雍和殿。

translations.literal: On wuxu the emperor died at Yonghe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor died in Yonghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，自古治世少而亂世多！

translations.literal: Alas! From antiquity ordered ages have been few and chaotic ages many!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—from antiquity ages of order have been few and ages of chaos many!

sentences.zh: 三代之王有天下者，皆數百年，其可道者，數君而已，況於後世邪！

translations.literal: The kings of the Three Dynasties who held the realm all ruled for several centuries, yet those of whom one can speak are only a few rulers—how much more so in later ages!
translations.idiomatic: Kings of the Three Dynasties who held All under Heaven each reigned for centuries, yet only a handful are worth recounting—what of later times!

sentences.zh: 況於五代邪！

translations.literal: How much more so in the Five Dynasties!
translations.idiomatic: What then of the Five Dynasties!

sentences.zh: 予聞長老為予言：「明宗雖出夷狄，而為人純質，寬仁愛人。

translations.literal: I have heard elders tell me: “Though Mingzong came from the barbarian lands, as a man he was plain and sincere, generous and loving to others.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard elders say: “Mingzong was born among the northern tribes, yet in character he was plain and sincere, magnanimous and humane.

sentences.zh: 」於五代之君，有足稱也。

translations.literal: ” Among the rulers of the Five Dynasties, he is worth praising.
translations.idiomatic: ” Among the sovereigns of the Five Dynasties, he alone is worth the telling.

sentences.zh: 嘗夜焚香，仰天而祝曰：「臣本蕃人，豈足治天下！

translations.literal: Once at night he burned incense, looked up to Heaven, and prayed: “Your servant is originally a frontier man—how could I be fit to rule All under Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: He would burn incense at night, lift his face to Heaven, and pray: “I am a tribesman at root—what right have I to govern the realm!

sentences.zh: 世亂久矣，願天早生聖人。

translations.literal: The age has long been in turmoil; may Heaven soon send forth a sage.
translations.idiomatic: The world has been torn too long; may Heaven soon raise up a sage.

sentences.zh: 」自初即位，減罷宮人、伶官；

translations.literal: ” From his first accession he reduced palace women and actor-officials;
translations.idiomatic: ” From the day he took the throne he cut back palace women and the actor-officials;

sentences.zh: 廢內藏庫，四方所上物，悉歸之有司。

translations.literal: he abolished the inner treasury, and all goods presented from the four directions were turned over entirely to the regular offices.
translations.idiomatic: he closed the inner treasury, and every tribute from the four quarters went straight to the responsible ministries.

sentences.zh: 廣壽殿火災，有司理之，請加丹雘，喟然嘆曰：「天以火戒我，豈宜增以侈邪！

translations.literal: When Guangshou Hall burned, the offices handled the matter and asked to add cinnabar lacquer. He sighed and said: “Heaven warns me with fire—how could I add to extravagance!
translations.idiomatic: After fire took Guangshou Hall the offices set the matter right and asked to restore it in vermilion lacquer. He sighed: “Heaven has warned me with flame—shall I answer with still more display!

sentences.zh: 」歲嘗旱，已而雪，暴出庭中，詔武德司宮中無得掃雪，曰：「此天所以賜我也。

translations.literal: ” In a year when drought had come and then snow, he let it lie exposed in the courtyard and decreed that the Wude Bureau was not to sweep snow within the palace, saying: “This is Heaven’s gift to me.
translations.idiomatic: ” One year, after drought, snow fell; he had it left lying in the courtyard and ordered the Wude Bureau not to clear snow inside the palace walls, saying, “This snow is Heaven’s gift to me.

sentences.zh: 」數問宰相馮道等民間疾苦，聞道等言谷帛賤，民無疾疫，則欣然曰：「吾何以堪之，當與公等作好事，以報上天。

translations.literal: ” He repeatedly asked the chief councillors Feng Dao and others about the people’s hardships. When Feng Dao and the rest said grain and cloth were cheap and the people free of plague, he rejoiced and said: “How can I bear such fortune? I must do good with you to repay Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: ” Again and again he asked Feng Dao and the other chief councillors how the people fared. When they reported cheap grain and cloth and no pestilence, he brightened and said, “Such blessing is more than I deserve—we must do good together and repay Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」吏有犯贓，輒置之死，曰：「此民之蠹也！

translations.literal: ” When any official was guilty of graft he at once put him to death, saying: “These are parasites on the people!
translations.idiomatic: ” Any official caught in corruption he put to death on the spot, saying, “These are worms in the people’s flesh!

sentences.zh: 」以詔書褒廉吏孫嶽等，以風示天下。

translations.literal: ” By imperial edict he praised honest officials such as Sun Yue, to instruct the realm.
translations.idiomatic: ” He issued edicts praising honest officers such as Sun Yue, to set the tone for the empire.

sentences.zh: 其愛人恤物，蓋亦有意於治矣。

translations.literal: His love of people and care for things showed that he truly meant to govern well.
translations.idiomatic: In cherishing men and sparing things he showed a real will to govern.

sentences.zh: 其即位時，春秋已高，不邇聲色，不樂遊畋。

translations.literal: When he took the throne he was already advanced in years; he did not draw near to sensual pleasure and did not delight in hunting.
translations.idiomatic: He was already old when he ascended; he kept his distance from music and women and took no joy in the chase.

sentences.zh: 在位七年，於五代之君，最為長世，兵革粗息，年屢豐登，生民實賴以休息。

translations.literal: He reigned seven years—the longest reign among the rulers of the Five Dynasties. Arms roughly fell silent; harvests were abundant year after year, and the people truly rested.
translations.idiomatic: Seven years on the throne—the longest of any Five Dynasties sovereign. War subsided in the main; harvests ran rich year on year, and the common people at last breathed easier.

sentences.zh: 然夷狄性果，仁而不明，屢以非辜誅殺臣下。

translations.literal: Yet the barbarian nature is decisive: he was benevolent but not clear-sighted, and repeatedly put ministers to death without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the tribal temper is swift and hard: he was kind but not discerning, and more than once executed ministers who had done no wrong.

sentences.zh: 至於從榮父子之間，不能慮患為防，而變起倉卒，卒陷之以大惡，帝亦由此飲恨而終。

translations.literal: As for father and son between Congrong and him, he could not plan against trouble in advance; rebellion rose in haste, and in the end Congrong was plunged into great guilt. The emperor, too, died at last nursing resentment because of it.
translations.idiomatic: Between himself and Congrong he failed to read trouble in time; the revolt broke without warning, and in the end Congrong was trapped in grave guilt. The emperor, too, carried bitterness to his grave.

sentences.zh: 當是時，大理少卿康澄上疏言時事，其言曰：「為國家者有不足懼者五，深可畏者六：三辰失行不足懼，天象變見不足懼，小人訛言不足懼，山崩川竭不足懼，水旱蟲蝗不足懼也；

translations.literal: At that time Kang Cheng, vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, submitted a memorial on current affairs. His words ran: “For one who holds a state there are five things not worth fearing and six deeply to be feared. The three luminaries out of course are not worth fearing; strange appearances in the heavens are not worth fearing; the false words of petty men are not worth fearing; mountains collapsing and rivers drying up are not worth fearing; flood, drought, insects, and locusts are not worth fearing;
translations.idiomatic: Then Kang Cheng, vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, memorialized on the times. He wrote: “For the man who holds a state, five things need not be feared and six should deeply alarm him. The sun, moon, and stars astray—no matter; omens in the sky—no matter; rumor from small men—no matter; mountains falling and rivers failing—no matter; flood, drought, insects, and locusts—no matter;

sentences.zh: 賢士藏匿深可畏，四民遷業深可畏，上下相徇深可畏，廉恥道消深可畏，毀譽亂真深可畏，直言不聞深可畏也。

translations.literal: worthy men in hiding is deeply to be feared; the four classes changing their occupations is deeply to be feared; superiors and inferiors covering for one another is deeply to be feared; the way of integrity and shame fading is deeply to be feared; slander and praise confounding truth is deeply to be feared; straight words not being heard is deeply to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: worthy men in hiding—deeply to be feared; the four classes abandoning their trades—deeply to be feared; superiors and subordinates shielding one another—deeply to be feared; integrity and shame worn thin—deeply to be feared; praise and blame twisting truth—deeply to be feared; honest counsel never reaching the throne—deeply to be feared.”

sentences.zh: 」識者皆多澄言切中時病。

translations.literal: ” Those who understood the times all approved Kang Cheng’s words as striking the age’s ills.
translations.idiomatic: ” Men of judgment praised Kang Cheng’s memorial for striking the sickness of the age.

sentences.zh: 若從榮之變，任圜、安重誨等之死，可謂上下相徇，而毀譽亂真之敝矣。

translations.literal: The rebellion of Congrong, the deaths of Ren Yuan and An Chonghui, and the like may be called superiors and inferiors covering for one another—the harm of slander and praise confounding truth.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong’s revolt, the deaths of Ren Yuan and An Chonghui—these were precisely superiors and subordinates shielding one another, and praise and blame twisting what was true.

sentences.zh: 然澄之言，豈止一時之病，凡為國者，可不戒哉！

translations.literal: Yet Kang Cheng’s words are not only the sickness of one time—everyone who holds a state should take warning!
translations.idiomatic: Yet Kang Cheng spoke to more than the ills of a single reign—whoever holds a state should heed him!
